explication: open-computer-use is a cross-platform computer-use service exposed through MCP, with CLI and JavaScript REPL entry points. Its core workflow is to discover applications, inspect accessibility state, dispatch a selected UI action, and return updated state. The README also documents permission onboarding, macOS cursor motion, and Linux/Windows runtimes. Some links reflect documented capabilities because their implementation excerpts were not sampled; optional peripheral wiring is omitted.
